l.i: per argumentis transfixit: vix ut Mihi
humilitatis obtentu deprimendos esse docuerit, ut Ego
larvam, hanc Illi detrahaṁ[?], quo vulnus
appareat: ac deindè Eum, in hac Causa,
erroris convincam, ex ipsis Sociorum suo-
rum confessionibus, imò suis. Quos non pa-
rum torqueri certum est, quoties sentiunt se

main_text.l: Iesuita fateri cogatur, Se impeditum esse,

marginalia.note: Maldon. in expos. unius Scripturæ Ioh.6.53.

page.notes: The left-margin note is set in very small type; I read it as "Maldon. in expos. unius Scripturæ" with "Ioh.6.53." beneath. The first letters are partly obscured, so "Maldon." may be an abbreviation of Maldonatus. "detrahaṁ[?]" is uncertain: the word may be "detraham" or "detrahat". "pœnis[?]" is uncertain at this resolution. Italic and roman type is distinguished by eye and is approximate; proper names and some words I took as roman. The faint "Digitized by Google" mark in the lower right corner is excluded as a digitiser's mark.
